reviewContext.note: No manifest.json present at reviews/sprint-1/input/. Reviewed from disk: skills/earn/bounty/run.sh, state/{bounties.json,gated.json}, spec 2026-06-30-earn-bounty-slot-design.md. Central question: can this loop actually earn real money.

bottomLine: As built, earn/bounty CANNOT make real money. It is a well-built FRONT HALF (discover + gate) with NO BACK HALF. Two hard holes must close before a first real dollar: (1) there is no 'attempt' mode — no code claims a bounty or opens a PR (run.sh case stmt = track|gate|*discover, line 116); the claim/PR is hand-waved to 'the brain' (line 7), so the loop cannot autonomously act on a gated bounty and never writes state/attempts.jsonl, which means track() also has no input. (2) track() never calls record-earn.mjs — on MERGED it only prints a string (line 58), so even a merged PR records $0; INV-7 is referenced in comments but never invoked, unlike gig/archive/run.sh:124-137 which actually runs record-earn. Secondary: no bounty-cli/cron/healthcheck (not a daily loop), and the gated.json on disk is STALE (predates the USD-not-token filter) so the spec's headline claim 'real-USD inventory = 0 verified' is NOT reproduced on disk — the artifact still lists the Rustchain token-farm as a survivor.
